episodeTitle.en: Inside Canva: Coaches not managers, giving away your Legos, and embracing AI | Cameron Adams
episodeTitle.zh: Canva内部：教练而非管理者，分享乐高积木，拥抱AI | 卡梅伦·亚当斯

guestBioOfficial.en: Cameron Adams is the co-founder and chief product officer of Canva. Canva is one of the world’s most valuable private software companies, used by 95% of Fortune 500 companies. Since its launch in 2013, Canva has grown to over 150 million monthly users in more than 190 countries, generating $2.3 billion in annual revenue. Prior to Canva, Cameron ran a design consultancy, worked at Google on Google Wave, and founded the email startup Fluent. He is also an author of five web design books and a regular speaker at global conferences. In our conversation, we discuss: • Why they spent a year building their minimum viable product (MVP) before launch
guestBioOfficial.zh:
卡梅伦·亚当斯（Cameron Adams）是Canva的联合创始人兼首席产品官。Canva是全球最具价值的私营软件公司之一，95%的《财富》500强企业都在使用该平台。自2013年推出以来，Canva已在190多个国家发展至每月1.5亿用户，年营收达23亿美元。在加入Canva之前，卡梅伦曾经营一家设计咨询公司，在谷歌参与Google Wave项目开发，并创立了邮件初创公司Fluent。他还是五本网页设计书籍的作者，并经常在全球会议上发言。在本次对谈中，我们探讨了以下内容：
• 他们为何在产品上线前花费一年时间打造最小可行产品（MVP）

title.en: Inside Canva: Coaches not managers, giving away your Legos, and embracing AI | Cameron Adams
title.zh: Canva内部：教练而非管理者，分享乐高积木，拥抱AI | 卡梅伦·亚当斯

summary.en: Cam shares how Canva stays product-obsessed at massive scale, including its freemium strategy and a unique culture where everyone has a coach and people “give away their Lego.” He discusses lessons on building MVPs, how the product team thinks about AI inside the product, and their SEO and growth strategy. The conversation also peeks into Canva's team culture and recent launches.
summary.zh: Cam 分享了 Canva 在超大规模下如何保持“产品痴迷”，包括免费增值策略，以及“人人都有教练、乐于交出手中积木”的独特文化。他讨论了打造 MVP 的教训、产品团队如何看待产品内的 AI，以及他们的 SEO 与增长策略。对话还一窥 Canva 的团队文化与近期发布。
